questions.question: As per the Constitution of India, Panchayats at the intermediate level may not be constituted in a state having a population not exceeding:
questions.solution:
• As per the Constitution of India, Panchayats at the intermediate level may not be constituted in a state having a population** not exceeding twenty lakhs.**
 
• PART IX Article 243(B) provides for Panchayati raj institutions in every village, district and state. It provides the conditions to be met for setting up a panchayat 
 
• The **73rd Constitutional Amendment Act(1992) provided a Constitutional status** to the Panchayati Raj Institutions in India through the insertion of Article 243 to Part IX of Indian Constitution.
 
• Part IX focused on organizing the **3 tier Panchayat system**, which would be constituted in every state at the village level, intermediate level and district level.

questions.question: During the occurrence of thunder and lightning:

options.text: lightning is seen before thunder is heard
whether lightning is seen first or thunder is heard first will depend upon the distance and angle of the clouds vis-a-vis earth
thunder is heard before lightning is seen
lightning is seen at the same time as thunder is heard

questions.solution:
__**Explanation:**__

**Thundering:** The continuous **sound produced** during the process of lightning.

 
• During the occurrence of thunder and lightning, **lightning is seen before thunder is heard as light travels faster than sound.**
 
• The speed of light is **3 x 10⁸ m/s **and the speed of sound is** 343 m/s.**
 
• When the positive and negative charges grow large enough, a giant spark or lightning occurs between the two charges within the cloud.

 

**Lightning is an electrical discharge** caused by imbalances between storm clouds and the ground, or within the clouds themselves.

 
• **Thunder is caused by lightning.** When a lightning bolt travels from the cloud to the ground it actually opens up a little hole in the air.

 

Once the light is gone the air collapses back in and creates a sound wave that we perceive as thunder and **so lightning is seen before thunder is heard.**

questions.question: Which protein protects the epithelial cells from damage?
questions.solution:
**__Keratin:-__**

 
• **Keratin protein** protects the epithelial cells from damage.
 
• **Epithelial cells are a type of cell that lines the surfaces of your body**.
 
• They are found on your skin, blood vessels, urinary tract, and organs.
 
• Keratin is the key structural material making up hair, nails, feathers, horns, claws, hooves, calluses, and the outer layer of skin among vertebrates.
 
• Keratin proteins **comprise the cytoskeletal component of these epithelia. **
 
• Keratin filaments are attached to the plasma membrane via desmosomes, and together these structural components form a three-dimensional array within the cytoplasm of epithelial cells and tissues.

questions.question: The process of transformation of a substance in a gaseous state into a liquid state due to change in pressure or temperature of the substance is called:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The process of transformation of a substance in a gaseous state into a liquid state due to change in pressure or temperature of the substance is called** "condensation".**
 
• Condensation is **caused by the loss of heat.**
 
• When moist air is cooled, it may reach a level when its capacity to hold water vapor ceases.
 
• Then, the excess water vapor condenses into liquid form. 
 
• If it directly condenses into solid form, it is known as sublimation.
 
• Condensation **also takes place when the moist air comes in contact** with some colder object and it may also take place when the temperature is close to the dew point.
 
• Condensation** depends upon the amount of cooling and the relative humidity of the air. **
 
• Condensation is** influenced by** the volume of air, temperature, pressure, and humidity.

 
 

 Name of the processes__

 Precipitation
 Precipitation is all liquid and solid water particles that fall from clouds and reach the ground.
 
 

 Evaporation
 Evaporation is the process by which an element or compound transitions from its liquid state to its gaseous state below the temperature at which it boils.
 
 

 Decantation
 Decantation is a process to separate mixtures by removing a liquid layer that is free of a precipitate.
 
 

 Condensation
 It is the deposition of a liquid or a solid from its vapor, generally upon a surface that is cooler than the adjacent gas

questions.question: Who was the founder of the Satyashodhak Samaj in the 19th century?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Jyotirao Phule.**__

 
• **Jyotirao Phule founded the Satyashodhak Samaj **in 1873 in present-day Maharashtra.
 
• **The objective of the Samaj **- to liberate the Shudras and to prevent their ‘exploitation’ by the upper caste Maratha.
 
• It campaigned against idolatry, denounced the chaturvarnya system (the caste system) and rejected the need for a Brahman priestly class as educational and religious leaders.
 
• Satyashodhak Samaj** campaigned for the spread of rational thinking and rejected the need for priests.** 
 
• Phule was a social activist and thinker, who pioneered women’s education in India, especially in Maharashtra.
 
• He established this Samaj with the ideals of human well-being, happiness, unity, equality, and easy religious principles and rituals.
 
• In 1873, he **wrote a book named Gulamgiri,** meaning slavery.

questions.question: The function of the retina is to:

options.text: lubricate the eye by releasing tears in a controlled way
close the eyes through the eyelids to prevent damage to the lens from excessive light
process the information gathered by photoreceptor cells and send it to the brain to decide what the picture is
adjust the focus of the lens for formation of a clear image

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**option 3.**__

__
 
• The function of the retina is to **process the information gathered by photoreceptor cells and send them to the brain to decide what the picture is.**__
 
• The retina is located near the optic nerve and is a thin layer of tissue that lines the back of the eye on the inside.
 
• The **purpose of the retina is to receive light that the lens has focused, convert the light into neural signals, and send these signals on to the brain for visual recognition.**
 
• The retina is a complex transparent tissue consisting of several layers, only one of which contains light-sensitive photoreceptor cells.
 
• The light must pass through the overlying layers to reach the photoreceptor cells.

questions.question: The term 'Askaryan effect' is associated with which functional area of science?
questions.solution:
• The term** 'Askaryan effect' is associated with the Physics** functional area of science.
 
• It is called the Askaryan effect or Askaryan radiation.
 
• The Askaryan effect is the **phenomenon whereby a particle traveling faster than the phase velocity of light in a dense dielectric medium **(such as salt, ice) produces a shower of secondary charged particles which contain a charge anisotropy and thus emits a cone 
of coherent radiation in the radio or microwave part of the electromagnetic spectrum.
 
• The Askaryan effect describes coherent electromagnetic radiation from high-energy cascades in dense media with a collective charge. 
 
• This effect is** closely related to the Cherenkov effect.**
 
• Cherenkov radiation/effect is light produced by charged particles when they pass through an optically transparent medium at speeds greater than the speed of light in that medium.

questions.question: What will happen if a glass bottle is completely filled with water, sealed with a lid and put into a freezer?

options.text: Eventually, the ice will burst the glass bottle
Weight of the glass bottle will increase after water freezes into ice
The glass bottle will be deformed due to atmospheric pressure on the bottle after the water freezes

questions.solution:
__
 
• The Glass bottle constitutes a closed system and when it is filled with water, the water fills the bottle completely.
 
• But when the water freezes, the ice expands and the volume of the water increases and the **bottle breaks because it is made of glass and glass cannot endure tensile stress which the ice exerts on the bottle.**__
 
• When ice expands its volume becomes 9-10% more than that of water. Hence, the glass bottle cannot accommodate the increase in the volume of 10% and hence it breaks.
 
• All inelastic materials will break when tensile stress is acting on them.

questions.question: Sweating or perspiration is nature’s way of:

options.text: releasing excess water from the body
releasing excess salt from the body
warding off harmful insects through the bad odour of the sweat
lowering the internal temperature of the body

questions.solution:
__
 
• Sweating is a process done by the body to regulate its temperature.
 
• When the body perspires the moisture then evaporates and takes excess heat with it.
 
• It leads to the **lowering of internal temperature.**__
 
• Sweat consists of **water and salts.**
 
• The perspiration works on the principles of the First and second laws of thermodynamics.
 
• __**Hypothalamus **__is responsible for sending the signal to the sweat-producing skin glands whenever the temperature of the body increases.
 
• If the temperature decreases, such glands constrict so that the production of sweat also gets reduced. 
 
• Hypothalamus is also responsible for the dilation of blood vessels.

questions.question: The 10 percent reservation in central government jobs under economically weaker sections (EWS) category is available to the persons whose family income is below:

questions.question: As per the Constitution of India, the National Capital Territory of Delhi shall have a Council of Ministers consisting of not more than ______ of the total number of members in the Legislative Assembly.
questions.solution:
__
 
• The National Capital Territory of Delhi shall have Council of Ministers consisting of not more than **10% or 0.1**__, of the total number of members in the Legislative Assembly, including the Chief Minister.
 
• __**69th constitutional amendment Act**__ made the Union territory of Delhi into a National capital region and provided for a state legislative assembly and a Lieutenant Governor.
 
• As per the **91st constitutional amendment act**, the strength of the council of ministers should** not exceed 15% to that of Lok sabha.**
 
• __**Article 81**__ caps the number of Lok Sabha seats at 550 of which 20 members are to be elected from Union Territories.

questions.question: The solar eclipse occurs when:

options.text: the moon moves too far away from the sun
the sun comes between the moon and the earth
the moon comes between the earth and the sun
an asteroid comes between the sun and the moon

questions.solution:
__
 
• A ‘solar eclipse’ occurs between sun rays and new moon when the moon passes directly in front of the sun so that its shadow lies on the earth.
 
• **The moon lies between the sun and the earth.**__
 
• The** ‘lunar eclipse’** takes place when the **earth comes in between the sun and the moon. A lunar eclipse takes place on a full moon.**
